agents.goal: Acquire the art for personal collection
agents.name: Agent3

causes.hypothesis: A more aggressive bidding strategy leads to a higher final price
causes.name: Bidding Strategy

causes.hypothesis: A higher starting price increases the final bid price
causes.name: Starting Price

causes.hypothesis: Bidders with a history of high bids are more likely to increase the final price
causes.name: Bidding History

interaction.stopping_rule: The auction ends when no more bids are placed or when the maximum bid is reached

outcome.measurement_question: What is the final price the art is sold for?
outcome.name: Final Bid Price
outcome.operationalization: The highest bid placed by any agent during the auction
outcome.respondent: Agent who placed the winning bid

scenario: 3 bidders participating in an auction for a piece of art starting at fifty dollars
